summary: Align the stale corner-placement helper and its regression fixtures with the canonical 270 degree right-wall orientation used by active placement and reflow.

impactAnalysis.notes: F-016 is a stale helper/test conflict, not a requested runtime behavior change. Active right-wall placement and reflow already use 270 degrees. This remediation changes the alternate corner helper so right-wall placements also use 270 degrees, keeps left-wall placement at 90 degrees, updates right-wall test fixtures, and adds a cross-path regression proving the helper and active reflow agree. No catalog, state, renderer, persistence, BOM, UI or composition semantics are intentionally changed.

e2e.reason: Placement/behavior domains are affected by the guarded helper change; the existing Chromium behavior flow is rerun to prove the active editor path remains unchanged while the stale helper is aligned.

risk.notes: The active runtime already uses 270 degrees on the right wall. Risk is limited to accidentally changing left-wall orientation or creating a regression in the alternate corner helper.

migration.notes: No persisted schema or project data changes.

rollback: Revert the corner helper/test alignment if right-wall corner regression coverage or placement validation fails.
